ValueSet-anc-b7-de22.description: JSON Schema for Persistent physiological symptoms - Breathless routine activities Choices ValueSet codes. Values are represented as Coding objects with 'system' and 'code' properties.
ValueSet-anc-b7-de22.narrative: This schema validates Coding-shaped objects for the Persistent physiological symptoms - Breathless routine activities Choices ValueSet. Each value must be an object with 'system' (CodeSystem URI) and 'code' (fragment after '#') properties. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/anc/ValueSet-anc-b7-de22.displays.json. The canonical IRI for a code can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
